title: Reagan proposes SDI at a cabinet meeting

tellings.quote: >> And he said, "Look, wouldn't it be wonderful at a cabinet meeting if we could design something that would protect us from missiles?"

plain: In 1983, at a cabinet meeting in the White House, President Ronald Reagan is said to have asked how wonderful it would be to design something that could protect the country from missiles, the idea that became his space-based missile defense plan, the Strategic Defense Initiative. John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, tells this as someone who was there. He tells it as the birth of that programme.
